# Module `lune_ui_platform::tray`

[API reference](../INDEX.md) / parent [`lune_ui_platform`](index.md)

The tray item: the notification-area icon on Windows, the menu-bar status item on macOS. It
holds an image and a tooltip and reports clicks with its rect; the surfaces it opens are the
app's, drawn in a [`crate::popover::PopoverWindow`](popover.md#struct.PopoverWindow) and placed by the core's `tray` module.

macOS and Windows go through `tray-icon`, with no menu attached and a non-template image (the
coloured dot could not survive a template). Other platforms have no tray: [`Tray::new`](tray.md#method.Tray.new) is
[`TrayError::Unsupported`](tray.md#variant.TrayError.Unsupported).

Source: `crates/lune-ui-platform/src/tray.rs:1`

**Methods and associated items**

`impl Tray`

- <a id="method.Tray.bar_is_dark"></a>`pub fn bar_is_dark(&self) -> Option<bool>`

  Whether the bar behind the item is dark, which picks the glyph's tone: the status button's
  effective appearance on macOS, `None` elsewhere. `None` too until the item is placed, as
  [`Tray::rect`](tray.md#method.Tray.rect) is, because an item not yet on the bar answers for no bar.

- <a id="method.Tray.new"></a>`pub fn new(image: TrayImage, tooltip: &str) -> Result<Tray, TrayError>`

  Puts `image` in the tray with `tooltip`. Call [`set_event_handler`](tray.md#fn.set_event_handler) first: without a handler
  no click reaches the app.

- <a id="method.Tray.rect"></a>`pub fn rect(&self) -> Option<TrayRect>`

  The item's rect now, or `None` while the OS has not placed it. On macOS that lasts until the
  event loop has run: straight after [`Tray::new`](tray.md#method.Tray.new) the status item has no height.

- <a id="method.Tray.set_image"></a>`pub fn set_image(&self, image: TrayImage) -> Result<(), TrayError>`

  Replaces the picture.

- <a id="method.Tray.set_tooltip"></a>`pub fn set_tooltip(&self, tooltip: &str) -> Result<(), TrayError>`

  Replaces the tooltip. Windows cuts a long one: its field holds 128 UTF-16 units.

## Functions

<a id="fn.set_event_handler"></a>
### Function `set_event_handler`

```rust
pub fn set_event_handler(f: impl Fn(TrayEvent) + Send + Sync + 'static)
```

Sets the handler of the tray's events. Only the first call takes effect, and it must come before
the first [`Tray::new`](tray.md#method.Tray.new): the OS layer fixes its route at the first event. The handler runs on the
thread the OS reports on, so it should only pass the event to the app's event loop.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-platform/src/tray.rs:116`
